# apipbx_blacklist_entry (Resource)

A blacklisted caller number. Import with "<tenant id>/<id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `number` (String) Digits (3-20); a leading + is dropped. Matched exactly against the caller number of calls from trunks.
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
